author: reek
body: On subsequent boots, FirstBoot checks DiskFacts for an existing identity, prompts for the passphrase, decrypts the key into the pinned kernel memory region, and proceeds to the console or configured boot target.

author: reek
body: Boot configuration is stored in DiskFacts via SysBootConfig (defined in DiskFacts.codex). The sysdb-write-boot-config and sysdb-find-boot-config functions handle serialization. The IdentityManager writes the initial BootConfigFact during the first-boot ceremony.
